role: CAP Sleep Database (capslpdb) preprocessing for validate_sleep.py: per record, reads the EDF ECG channel, detects R peaks with wfdb XQRS at 250 Hz in 5-min chunks with native-rate refinement, parses the RemLogic hypnogram, and writes <DATA_ROOT>/capslpdb/derived/<rec>.json (or <rec>.skip.json).
state: ECG_LABELS tried in order: ECG1-ECG2, ECG, EKG, ekg (line 39)
toplevel: Inserts the script directory into sys.path (needed under python -I), imports numpy/scipy/wfdb; runs main() as a script.

units.does: Converts 'hh:mm:ss' or 'hh.mm.ss' to seconds (float); a value with fractional seconds written with '.' raises ValueError on unpacking.

Parses a RemLogic hypnogram .txt: finds the 'Sleep Stage' header row, keeps rows whose Event starts with 'SLEEP-', converts clock time to seconds after EDF start (adds 24 h when < -6 h), and lays them on a 30-s epoch grid starting at the first row; each row fills max(1, round(dur/30)) epochs. Returns (t0_s, epochs mapped via EPOCH_MAP with None for MT/UNSCORED, raw tokens).

branches.cond: for each line after the header
row too short or Event not SLEEP-*
for each 30-s epoch the row covers

units.does: R-peak detector: resamples the ECG to 250 Hz (resample_poly with a rational factor), runs wfdb XQRS on 5-min chunks padded by 10 s and keeps only peaks inside each chunk's own 5 min, maps back to native samples, then refines each to the max |5-20 Hz band-passed| sample within +/-50 ms. Returns sorted unique peak sample indices.

CLI: for each record argument, tries ECG_LABELS until edf_read_channel succeeds; if none, writes <rec>.skip.json and continues; otherwise parses the hypnogram, detects peaks, converts to (t_ms, rr_ms) points and writes <rec>.json with record, ecg_label, fs, edf_start, detector string, n_peaks, duration_h, first_epoch_ms, epochs, epoch_tokens, rr_points; prints summary statistics.

branches.effect: try next label (any header-parse ValueError is also treated as 'label missing')
writes skip JSON and continues (n16 in the run)

flags.text: Any ValueError from edf_read_channel (including a malformed header int()/float() parse, not only a missing label) is swallowed as 'no ECG channel; skipped', so a corrupt EDF is reported as a record without ECG.
